column4: Conjunction is commutative
Disjunction is commutative
The contrapositive of an implication follows from it
Double negation elimination
A universal quantifier distributes over conjunction
An existential quantifier distributes over disjunction
Negating a universal gives an existential counterexample
Intersection is commutative
Union distributes over intersection
Subset inclusion is transitive
A composition of injections is an injection
A composition of surjections is a surjection
A set is contained in the preimage of its image
The Gauss sum, stated without division so it lives entirely in ℕ
Every natural is smaller than its own power of two
If n² is even then n is even
There is no rational whose square is 2
A left identity in a monoid is *the* identity
Unfolding the successor case of monoid exponentiation
Inverses in a group are unique
The inverse of an inverse is the original element
An element in two subgroups lies in their intersection
A field has no zero divisors
In characteristic two, every element is its own additive inverse
The tower law: degrees multiply up a tower of finite extensions
The degree of a simple extension is the degree of the minimal polynomial
